title: Unknown methodology error should suggest the path form for a project bundle
description: Biblicus on 0.36.0: methodologies: [biblicus] fails with 'Error: unknown methodology: biblicus (built-in methodologies: bdd, git-flow)' although methodologies/biblicus/METHODOLOGY.md exists; bundles need '- path: methodologies/biblicus'. When methodologies/<name>/METHODOLOGY.md exists, the error should say: did you mean '- path: methodologies/<name>'? Same message in both runtimes; spec it.
